title: Technical Debt Quadrant
summary: Martin Fowler's technical debt quadrant: debt is prudent or reckless, deliberate or inadvertent; even good teams accrue inadvertent debt, and quick-and-dirty usually underestimates the design payoff.

assertions.quote: the useful distinction isn't between debt or non-debt, but between prudent and reckless debt
it can take a year of programming on a project before you understand what the best design approach should have been

verdicts.note: Matches design-emergence research and practitioner consensus; not experimentally tested.

assertions.quote: The whole point of good design and clean code is to make you go faster
A particular benefit of the debt metaphor is that it's very handy for communicating to non-technical people.
